scripts.test: rm -rf .test-dist && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && mkdir -p .test-dist/public/application && cp public/application/meal-service.js .test-dist/public/application/meal-service.js && node --test .test-dist/tests/*.test.js tests/*.test.mjs
